stem: Which of these best describes what the author of “Car Talk” and Brandy in “Needed” gain from the experience of driving?

options.label: A
options.text: Both gain a deeper understanding of their own abilities.

options.label: B
options.text: Both gain a deeper understanding of family members.

options.label: C
options.text: The author of “Car Talk” becomes a skilled driver, while Brandy learns how to farm.

options.label: D
options.text: The author of “Car Talk” gets to know her father, while Brandy gets to help her family.
